verdict_text: The latent-space separation between auto and manual tile embeddings is statistically significant (p=0.0000 < 0.05). This upgrades RQ4 from purely observational to statistically supported.
note: This permutation test operates on structural-feature MLP embeddings (N=45 tiles, 9 features). The primary GNN result (lane-graph GCN, N=72, cross-cosine=-0.160) remains the thesis-grade evidence. This test provides additional statistical grounding. The primary encoder is NT-Xent self-supervised, so permutation significance depends on whether the learned representation happens to separate auto/manual tiles as a consequence of structural distribution differences.
